summary: This bill reauthorizes the Chesapeake Bay Office of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, specifying its leadership, expanding its coordination and program activities to include coastal hazards, climate change, education, and integrated ecosystem assessments, and establishing new programs for education and coastal living resources management.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and expands the activities of the NOAA Chesapeake Bay Office, focusing on restoration, research, education, and management of the Chesapeake Bay ecosystem. It explicitly mentions addressing 'coastal hazards and climate change' and aims to protect and restore living resources and habitats, which directly contributes to environmental protection.
